"""Validate the product API on the retained index and held-out synthetic queries."""
import argparse
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks import vector_scale_bench as bench
from commontrace.vector_lance import ANN_REFINE_FACTOR, LanceVectorIndex

async def run(baseline, sweep):
    index = LanceVectorIndex(baseline['retained_benchmark_store'], tenant=bench.TENANT,
                             namespace=bench.NAMESPACE, model=bench.MODEL, dimension=baseline['dim'])
    try:
        probes = sweep['probes']
        truths = [set(values) for values in sweep['truths']]
        for query in probes[:5]:
            await index.search(query, top_k=baseline['top_k'])
        rounds = []
        for _ in range(3):
            times, recalls = [], []
            for query, truth in zip(probes, truths):
                started = time.perf_counter()
                hits = await index.search(query, top_k=baseline['top_k'])
                times.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
                recalls.append(len(truth & {h.key for h in hits}) / len(truth))
            cohorts = {}
            for name, start, end in [('tuning_queries', 0, 20), ('held_out_queries', 20, 40)]:
                cohort_times, cohort_recalls = times[start:end], recalls[start:end]
                cohorts[name] = {'samples_ms': cohort_times, 'recalls': cohort_recalls,
                                 'p50_ms': statistics.median(cohort_times),
                                 'p95_ms': bench._percentile(cohort_times, .95),
                                 'recall_at_k': statistics.mean(cohort_recalls),
                                 'recall_min': min(cohort_recalls)}
            rounds.append(cohorts)
            print(json.dumps({name: {key: cohort[key] for key in ('p95_ms', 'recall_at_k', 'recall_min')}
                              for name, cohort in cohorts.items()}), flush=True)
        paths = ['commontrace/vector_lance.py','commontrace/vector_store.py',
                 'commontrace/async_workers.py','benchmarks/vector_scale_bench.py',
                 'tests/test_optional_memory_backends.py']
        return {'scope': 'Product vector component only; excludes inference, hybrid fusion and canonical admission',
                'n': baseline['n'], 'dim': baseline['dim'], 'top_k': baseline['top_k'],
                'refine_factor': ANN_REFINE_FACTOR, 'rounds': rounds,
                'source_base': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
                'source_files_sha256': {p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
                'baseline_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(args.baseline).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                'sweep_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(args.sweep).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                'diagnostic_source': Path(__file__).read_text()}
    finally:
        await index.close()

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('baseline');p.add_argument('sweep');p.add_argument('out')
args = p.parse_args()
result = asyncio.run(run(json.load(open(args.baseline)), json.load(open(args.sweep))))
Path(args.out).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
